title: Passing Arguments
objective: Use positional arguments, keyword arguments, and default values.

sourceAlignment.title: Python Crash Course, 3rd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Eric Matthes
sourceAlignment.note: Alignment metadata only. Lesson prose and exercises are original Code Forge material.

paragraphs: By default, arguments are matched to parameters by position — the first argument fills the first parameter, the second fills the second, and so on. Getting the order wrong silently assigns values to the wrong parameters.
Keyword arguments let you name which parameter each value goes to, in any order: forge_sword(metal="steel", length=30). This removes any ambiguity about order and makes a call easier to read.

A parameter can have a default value, written as name=value in the def line. Any call that leaves that argument out uses the default instead, so you only need to specify it when you want something different.
explanation.rule: Positional arguments are matched by order; keyword arguments are matched by name; a default value fills in when an argument is left out.

examples.title: Positional, Keyword, and Default
examples.code:
def forge_sword(metal, length=30):
    print(metal, length)

forge_sword("steel")
forge_sword("iron", 25)
forge_sword(length=40, metal="bronze")
examples.note: The first call uses the default length. The third call uses keyword arguments in a different order than the def line.

feedback.incorrect: A default value fills in automatically whenever that argument is omitted.

assignment.title: Forge Order
assignment.brief: Write forge_order(metal, quantity=1) that prints metal followed by ' x' followed by quantity, e.g. 'steel x1'.
requirements: Define forge_order(metal, quantity=1) with a default value for quantity.
Call forge_order('steel') relying on the default.
assignment.starterCode:
def forge_order(metal, quantity=1):
    # Print metal + ' x' + str(quantity)
    pass

forge_order("steel")

hints: Give quantity a default value of 1 in the def line.
Build the message with metal + ' x' + str(quantity).
Calling forge_order('steel') should use quantity's default of 1.
The output should read exactly: steel x1
